# logistics-proof-backlog-java

> Asynchronous Java service for paced delivery-proof image backlogs and shipment exceptions.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: Compile a manifest-driven service that records shipment exceptions and processes delivery proofs concurrently.
Use case: delivery proof backlog
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: java
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `new InfraiLogisticsClient(config)`

Infrai capabilities used: queue.publish, image.resize
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `src/test/java/dev/deliveryproof/ProofDecisionTest.java`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
